title: Spend by provider and service category
intro: Start here. Billed cost is what the invoice says; effective cost spreads commitment purchases across the usage they cover.
sql:
SELECT
  ServiceProviderName,
  ServiceCategory,
  round(sum(BilledCost), 2)    AS BilledCost,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost), 2) AS EffectiveCost,
  count(*)                     AS Rows
FROM CostAndUsage
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY EffectiveCost DESC;
feature: Lab practice queries (DuckDB SQL, not from FOCUS)

title: What kinds of charge are in the bill?
intro: ChargeCategory is a closed list: Usage, Purchase, Tax, Credit, Adjustment. Look for values that should not be there.
sql:
SELECT
  ServiceProviderName,
  ChargeCategory,
  ChargeClass,
  count(*)                  AS Rows,
  round(sum(BilledCost), 2) AS BilledCost
FROM CostAndUsage
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ServiceProviderName, ChargeCategory;
feature: Lab practice queries (DuckDB SQL, not from FOCUS)

title: Effective savings rate by provider
intro: ESR = 1 - effective cost / list cost, on usage. Correction rows (ChargeClass = 'Correction') are excluded. The sample's costs are anonymised, so read the method, not the number.
sql:
SELECT
  ServiceProviderName,
  round(sum(ListCost), 2)      AS ListCost,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost), 2) AS EffectiveCost,
  round(1 - sum(EffectiveCost) / nullif(sum(ListCost), 0), 4) AS EffectiveSavingsRate
FROM CostAndUsage
WHERE ChargeCategory = 'Usage'
  AND ChargeClass IS NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ListCost DESC;
feature: Lab practice queries (DuckDB SQL, not from FOCUS)

title: Commitment discount utilisation
intro: Used vs Unused commitment, by type. Utilisation = used effective cost / (used + unused).
sql:
SELECT
  CommitmentDiscountType,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost) FILTER (WHERE CommitmentDiscountStatus = 'Used'), 2)   AS UsedCost,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost) FILTER (WHERE CommitmentDiscountStatus = 'Unused'), 2) AS UnusedCost,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost) FILTER (WHERE CommitmentDiscountStatus = 'Used')
        / nullif(sum(EffectiveCost), 0), 4)                                       AS Utilisation
FROM CostAndUsage
WHERE CommitmentDiscountId IS NOT NULL
  AND ChargeCategory = 'Usage'
GROUP BY ALL;

title: Tag keys in use (allocation hygiene)
intro: Every tag key and how much cost carries it. Spot the near-duplicates that break allocation.
sql:
SELECT
  k                            AS TagKey,
  count(*)                     AS Rows,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost), 2) AS EffectiveCost
FROM CostAndUsage, unnest(json_keys(Tags)) AS t(k)
WHERE Tags IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY Rows DESC;
feature: Lab practice queries (DuckDB SQL, not from FOCUS)

title: Allocation coverage: share of cost with an application tag
intro: The classic allocation KPI: what share of cost can be attributed to an owner?
sql:
SELECT
  ServiceProviderName,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost), 2) AS EffectiveCost,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost) FILTER (WHERE Tags ->> '$.application' IS NOT NULL)
        / nullif(sum(EffectiveCost), 0), 4) AS ApplicationTaggedShare
FROM CostAndUsage
WHERE ChargeCategory = 'Usage'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY EffectiveCost DESC;
feature: Lab practice queries (DuckDB SQL, not from FOCUS)

title: Daily cost trend
intro: Cost per day by provider, from ChargePeriodStart.
sql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', ChargePeriodStart) AS Day,
  ServiceProviderName,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost), 2)         AS EffectiveCost
FROM CostAndUsage
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY Day, ServiceProviderName;

title: Top 10 resources by effective cost
intro: Where the money goes, resource by resource.
sql:
SELECT
  ResourceId,
  ResourceName,
  ServiceName,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost), 4) AS EffectiveCost
FROM CostAndUsage
WHERE ResourceId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY EffectiveCost DESC
LIMIT 10;

title: Marketplace purchases (service provider is not the host)
intro: FOCUS 1.3+ separates who sells the service from who hosts it. In this sample, Red Hat and Datadog are bought through AWS.
sql:
SELECT
  HostProviderName,
  ServiceProviderName,
  InvoiceIssuerName,
  ServiceName,
  ChargeCategory,
  round(sum(BilledCost), 2) AS BilledCost,
  count(*)                  AS Rows
FROM CostAndUsage
WHERE ServiceProviderName <> HostProviderName
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY BilledCost DESC;

title: Data quality checks a validator would make
intro: Rows that break simple FOCUS rules. Each count should be zero in conformant data.
sql:
SELECT 'ChargeCategory outside the allowed values' AS Check,
       count(*) AS Rows
FROM CostAndUsage
WHERE ChargeCategory NOT IN ('Usage', 'Purchase', 'Tax', 'Credit', 'Adjustment')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ChargePeriodEnd not after ChargePeriodStart', count(*)
FROM CostAndUsage WHERE ChargePeriodEnd <= ChargePeriodStart
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Charge period outside its billing period', count(*)
FROM CostAndUsage
WHERE ChargePeriodStart < BillingPeriodStart OR ChargePeriodEnd > BillingPeriodEnd
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Usage row with no ConsumedQuantity', count(*)
FROM CostAndUsage WHERE ChargeCategory = 'Usage' AND ConsumedQuantity IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Tag key with leading or trailing spaces', count(*)
FROM CostAndUsage, unnest(json_keys(Tags)) AS t(k) WHERE k <> trim(k);

title: AI token cost by model and token type (1.5 examples)
intro: FOCUS 1.5 puts model identity and token type in SkuPriceDetails. Switch the data source to the spec 1.5 worked examples to see rows.
sql:
SELECT
  SkuPriceDetails ->> '$.ModelId'          AS ModelId,
  SkuPriceDetails ->> '$.TokenDirection'   AS TokenDirection,
  SkuPriceDetails ->> '$.TokenCacheAction' AS TokenCacheAction,
  sum(ConsumedQuantity)                    AS Tokens,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost), 4)             AS EffectiveCost,
  round(sum(EffectiveCost) * 1e6 / nullif(sum(ConsumedQuantity), 0), 4) AS CostPerMillionTokens
FROM CostAndUsage
WHERE ConsumedUnit = 'Tokens'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ModelId, TokenDirection, TokenCacheAction;
feature: Lab practice queries (DuckDB SQL, not from FOCUS)
